contracts.native_contract: Main-thread-only capability acquired by Apple's main-thread predicate
Contain Rust panic and Objective-C message exception at a reusable native call boundary
contracts.result: Original T on success; fixed-size NativeFaultKind::Unwind on failure

contracts.adaptation: Accepted NSException initializer is feature-gated behind disabled NSDictionary/NSObjCRuntime features; NSString's invalid-range API generates the real Foundation NSException without changing the accepted feature selection.

contracts.native_contract: Inbound callback must contain unwind before ABI return and select ABI-valid fallback
contracts.status: No callback exists in this work order; callback-specific fallback and failure latching remain with each future callback implementation.

fault_payload_policy: No arbitrary panic or native payload is retained. Payload drop runs under a secondary unwind guard; Err(_secondary_payload) remains bound through the divergent std::process::abort() call, so its destructor never executes. No secondary payload is leaked or allowed to unwind across the boundary.

fatal_cleanup_regression.method: Subprocess re-exec of the integration test binary; original panic payload Drop uses panic_any(SecondaryPanicsOnDrop), whose Drop panics
fatal_cleanup_regression.expected: Child terminates by SIGABRT (signal 6); parent asserts the signal and the secondary payload destructor is not run

limitations: No fence for raw C/CF, retain/release or Drop cleanup, foreign cleanup exceptions, or panic=abort/allocator abort.
No application-model borrow may span a reentrant native call.
No macOS 13 runtime, full AppKit startup, renderer, or product acceptance claim.
